summary: Syslog/forwarder schema mapping and retention attestation for regulated audit exports
description:
Issue summary:
MedData Analytics (enterprise) has submitted a security questionnaire and requests a formal artifact bundle and technical details to support their SOC2 and PCI assessments. They need: (1) exact syslog/CEF/JSON event schema we emit for tenant audit events, including field-level descriptions and examples; (2) confirmation of retention policy (how long raw audit events and normalized events are retained) and an attestation statement that deletion is performed when TTL expires; (3) a one-time sample export for 2026-02-01 to 2026-03-01 containing anonymized events, checksums, and a manifest; (4) instructions and an anchor config for configuring a push-based syslog forwarder or pull-based S3 export for their SIEM ingestion.

Impact:
Customer compliance deadline for SOC2 readiness is 2026-03-20; they cannot complete their evidence package without the artifacts. No production outage, but this is blocking audit acceptance.

Environment:
- Redwood hosted (prod) for customer tenant meddata-prod (us-east region)
- Default audit pipeline with daily indexing and optional long-term cold store

Steps to reproduce / request details:
1. Customer submitted questionnaire (attached) asking for raw audit schema and retention attestation.
2. Requested sample export and manifest.
3. Requested guidance for live forwarding into customer SIEM (syslog/CEF vs S3).

Requested artifacts:
- JSON schema for audit events (tenant- and org-scoped events)
- Retention policy statement and deletion log proof for a sample event
- Sample export (anonymized) covering 2026-02-01 to 2026-03-01 with SHA256 checksums and a manifest.csv
- Example syslog forwarder config (rsyslog/Fluentd snippet) and CEF mapping
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Aisha Khan (Reporter): Created ticket after receiving security questionnaire PDF from customer. Attached questionnaire and requested due date of 2026-03-20.
2026-03-10 10:05 - Priya Menon (Assignee): Acknowledged. Looping SRE and Data Privacy. Will confirm retention TTL and feasibility of sample export by EOD.

2026-03-10 13:40 - Miguel Herrera (SRE): Confirmed audit pipeline uses write-ahead buffer into S3 cold store with default TTL 365 days for raw events; normalized index kept 90 days by default. Noted that sample export is possible but we must redact PII before handoff. Linked PR for exporter tool.

2026-03-11 08:22 - Legal (Nora Liu): Requested formal DPA pointer and asked for assurance on irreversible deletion process for expired objects; asked to include retention delete-job run logs for a single sample object id.

2026-03-12 14:30 - Priya Menon: Posted sample export manifest and a small anonymized sample (S3 presigned link) and a draft attestation statement. Asked customer to confirm receipt and whether syslog push or S3 pull is preferred. Marked ticket Waiting on Customer.

2026-03-12 16:05 - Customer (MedData contact - Daniel Park): Confirmed receipt of sample and attestation. Asking for rsyslog CEF mapping examples and a short Zoom to validate field mappings next week.
investigation_notes: Checked audit-exporter service logs: no evident errors for meddata-prod since 2026-02-01. Export pipeline creates daily objects with prefix tenant/meddata-prod/audit/YYYY-MM-DD/.
Found exporter PR: github.com/redwood-inference/audit-exporter/pull/482 (adds presigned S3 manifest generation) - referenced for sample packaging.

Retention: cold-store lifecycle configured in infra repo (infra/audit-lifecycle.yaml) with transition to Glacier-like cold tier at 180d and deletion lifecycle at 365d. Confirmed by Miguel (SRE) with snapshot of lifecycle rule id lifecycle-2023-11.

PII redaction: exporter supports redaction pipeline rule sets. For sample we ran redaction rule set 'compliance-minimal' which blanked credential and user_email fields and replaced user_id with hashed id. Kept event types and timestamps intact.

Syslog mapping: audit events include fields timestamp, tenant_id, org_id, event_type, actor_type, actor_id (hashed), resource_type, resource_id, meta (freeform). Provided mapping to CEF extension keys and example rsyslog template in artifacts.
resolution: Provided customer with: 1) JSON schema for audit events (v2.1) and field descriptions; 2) retention attestation statement drafted by Legal and signed by Compliance; 3) anonymized sample export for 2026-02-01..2026-03-01 (S3 presigned bundle link) with manifest.csv and SHA256 checksums; 4) two example forwarder configurations (rsyslog and Fluentd) showing CEF mapping and TLS syslog push. Follow-ups: schedule Zoom on 2026-03-15 to validate mappings and confirm whether they will consume via syslog push or S3 pull. Also note action item to offer dedicated one-time S3 bucket for customer if they prefer isolation (internal task INT-3378).
